title: AI Service Desk — Pick a Receipt
principle: Do not collect tools. Choose a receipt, then choose the smallest official-tool stack that can help you make it.
directory_rules: Official product, documentation, or education-program links only.
Access labels are navigation lenses, not pricing or eligibility promises.
Check current pricing, access, regional availability, data terms, and student eligibility at the source.
Use public-safe test data, test modes, verified recipients, preview deployments, and hard spend limits first.
Keep the brief, sources, code, edit decisions, and receipt portable if a paid service disappears.

access_lenses.start-free: The official source currently presents a free starting path or generally free product entry; limits and terms may change.
access_lenses.open: An open standard, open ecosystem, or locally available tool; individual assets, models, and licenses still require review.
access_lenses.student: A verified-student program with changing eligibility and offers; recent graduates may not qualify.
access_lenses.metered: Usage, credits, test mode, plan access, or API billing may apply. Set a limit before use.
